learning_outcomes.text: Apply the basic principles governing the movement of machines and mechanisms in solving real cases of industrial machinery.
Recognize and understand the principles of machine and mechanism theory applied in the analysis of industrial machine movement.
Recognize and understand the training needs that will be useful to successfully solve new situations related to industrial engineering.
Design in the field of industrial technical engineering.
Develop projects in the field of industrial technical engineering.
Propose creative solutions to satisfactorily respond to real needs and problems of society.
Adapt the organization of content and the use of language, verbal and non-verbal, to argue in diverse situations or before diverse audiences.
Develop measurements, calculations, valuations, appraisals, expert reports, studies, reports, work plans, and other tasks typical of the field of technical engineering.
Apply the knowledge of industrial engineering in learning new methods and theories.
Show the advantages and opportunities of different solutions to the same problem in a critical and constructive way.
Correctly and pertinently use specifications, regulations, and mandatory standards.
Apply the principles and methods of quality.

syllabus_topics: Block I: BASIC CONCEPTS OF MACHINES AND MECHANISMS
Topic 1: BASIC CONCEPTS OF MACHINES AND MECHANISMS
Block III: STATIC AND DYNAMIC FORCE ANALYSIS
assessment_rules: The student will take tests with theoretical and practical content throughout the course. The student must submit a report on the practicals carried out. The final grade is determined by 80% from mixed tests and 20% from assignments.
